context: Ongoing: Building the first three hip and knee actuators. This week: Build retro: kitting list lived in a spreadsheet nobody updated.
Ongoing: Whether the hip keeps the in-house cycloidal reducer or buys a harmonic drive for DVT. This week: Decision: hip stays cycloidal through DVT, revisit for PVT; knee stays harmonic.
Ongoing: Absolute encoder on the knee output glitches when the motor runs above 8 A. This week: Bao scopes it: common-mode noise on the SSI clock, cable runs alongside motor phases.
Ongoing: Getting dyno and gantry logs into one place with consistent timestamps. This week: Elena: dyno logs are CSVs on a lab laptop, gantry logs on another.
Ongoing: Coupling misalignment corrupting efficiency numbers on the dyno. This week: Bellows coupling replaces the jaw coupling; repeatability within 0.6%.
